worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.summary: Drop your whole flame-covered body from above: the more you outweigh the target, the harder it hits and the more likely it sets the target ablaze. The landing shock scatters everyone around and scorches the ground into hot footing. The scorching form spreads wider and ignites more; the heavy form hits harder and faster.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.use.0: Crush a lighter target under your weight and press the fire in
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.use.1: Leave a patch of hot ground that burns the feet
The slam deals about %1$s contact damage to every enemy within a %2$s block landing radius and shoves them outward; the more you outweigh a target, the harder it hits.

A struck target has a %1$s chance to catch fire and burn for about %2$s s: while burning its physical damage is halved and it loses about 6.25%% of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1); on impact it is also set alight for about %3$s s. Fire-type or burn-immune targets cannot be lit.

Leaps from up to %1$s blocks away, %2$s blocks high with %3$s s of air time, then slams the landing spot locked in at take-off; a foe that moves away during the air time dodges it. Targets in the landing area are shoved %4$s blocks.
The ground around the landing spot is scorched into magma blocks over about %1$s blocks and stays for about %2$s s; it burns the feet, and the original blocks return when it ends.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.scorch.on: Scorching form: a wider scorch, a higher ignite chance and a longer burn, at the cost of slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.scorch.off: Heavy form: a heavier, faster fiery slam that leaves only a small scorch mark.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.timing: Leap from within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.growth.0: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.growth.1: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s and the scorch radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.preference.s: On: a wider scorch, a higher ignite chance and a longer burn, but slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a heavier, faster fiery slam that leaves only a small scorch mark.
worldcombat.skill.heatcrash.preference.a: Only leap once a foe is within this distance. Larger values pounce from further away and are easier to dodge during the air time.
On: it will not leap at a target already burning, saving the ignite for those it can still set alight. Off: it slams regardless.
It only opens with Heat Crash when its own weight is at least this many times the target's; 0 means always. Raise it to slam only when clearly heavier.
